title: The weak law of large numbers for the friendship paradox index
summary: The friendship paradox index is a network summary statistic used to quantify the friendship paradox, which describes the tendency for an individual's friends to have more friends than the individual. In this paper, we utilize Markov's inequality to derive the weak law of large numbers for the friendship paradox index in a random geometric graph, a widely-used model for networks with spatial dependence and geometry.
